BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be

amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 6-H in the area bounded by:
A public alley next north of and parallel to West 23" Place; a line 238 feet
east of and parallel to South Oakley Avenue; West 23" Place; and a line
213 feet east of and parallel to South Oakley Avenue;

to those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2236 West 23 Place
